narration.text: Two floors, fixed before the names go in. Thirty billion on your own records. Twenty billion on everyone else's. Five clear the left floor. Seven clear the right. Panels come together and two names are standing in the middle. Drake. And Travis Scott.
narration.measuredTranscript: Two floors fixed before the names go in. 30 billion on your own records. 20 billion on everyone else's. Watch this one. Count who clears both. 5 clear the left floor. 7 clear the right. Panels come together. And two names are standing in the middle. Drake and Travis Scott.

extension.reason: Continue the two-person Drake/Travis scene through the following Drake/Travis comparison at native speed.
extension.overlapNarration: Travis belongs there, and he got there in fewer years. But look at the distance inside the overlap.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: Two thresholds are set in advance, and only two names clear both.

claims.text: The thresholds are 30 billion on own records and 20 billion on others'.
Five clear the first, seven clear the second.
Drake and Travis Scott clear both.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Both thresholds declared before any name appears, with the five and the seven shown against them.
Portraits of the two who clear both, presented without numbers. User ruling on this passage: a side-by-side qualitative comparison follows the threshold overview.
